command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== htseq-count on the SAME fixture bytes (-s no matches featureCounts' default) =="
htseq-count -f sam -t exon -i gene_id -s no reads.sam genes.gtf > hts.txt 2>hts.log
grep -v '^__' hts.txt > hts_counts.txt
cat hts_counts.txt
echo "-- htseq's own accounting --"; grep '^__' hts.txt

TOTAL=$(awk '!/^@/{n++} END{print n+0}' reads.sam)
PLANTED=$(awk '{s+=$2} END{print s+0}' truth.txt)
NOFEAT=$(awk '/^__no_feature/{print $2}' hts.txt)
FC_OK=no; cmp -s <(sort truth.txt) <(sort fc_counts.txt) && FC_OK=yes
HT_OK=no; cmp -s <(sort truth.txt) <(sort hts_counts.txt) && HT_OK=yes
AGREE=no; cmp -s <(sort fc_counts.txt) <(sort hts_counts.txt) && AGREE=yes
HT_SUM=$(awk '{s+=$2} END{print s+0}' hts.txt)

{
  echo "RNA-seq read counting -- two tools, one fixture, counts known by construction"
  echo "featurecounts_version v2.1.1 (subread image tag 2.1.1; featureCounts is not installed in the htseq image)"
  echo "htseq_version         $(htseq-count --version 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1{print $NF}')"
  echo "reads_total           $TOTAL   (of which $PLANTED planted in genes, rest intergenic)"
  echo "featurecounts_matches_truth $FC_OK   (assert yes -- EXACT integer counts)"
  echo "htseq_matches_truth         $HT_OK   (assert yes -- EXACT)"
  echo "tools_agree                 $AGREE   (assert yes -- cross-validation on identical bytes)"
  echo "htseq_no_feature      $NOFEAT   (assert == intergenic reads -- non-genic reads excluded, not absorbed)"
  echo "htseq_accounting_sum  $HT_SUM of $TOTAL   (assert equal -- conservation: every read accounted for)"
  echo "note  agreement here is not a stranding artifact: all reads are forward-strand on + genes, so htseq's -s yes default gives the same counts (verified)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$FC_OK" = yes
test "$HT_OK" = yes
test "$AGREE" = yes
test "$NOFEAT" -eq $((TOTAL - PLANTED))
test "$HT_SUM" -eq "$TOTAL"
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
